footnote: Basis: channel stock divided by average daily shipments at stores on the board, monthly average
notes: This one was mostly mine. Restocking used to run on monthly reports, dealers sat on more than 50 days of stock, and the surplus leaked out cheap into other regions. I built a weekly restock board covering the chain stores, carrier stores and 50 key stores, with suggestions based on actual sell-through. Stock cover fell from 52 days to 34, and complaints about cross-region selling from 27 to 6. The channel reps keep the board's data up to date each week.
